续派成功：K01 已在原核验会话（a9a2aba4）恢复 first-review，单元状态回到 `running`，`interruptions:1` 已记录。

**本轮处置（事实）**
- 核验方上次中断原因：子会话报 error，报错前最后动作是“取全文清单”，**尚未提交任何核验结论**，即无半成品判定被沿用。
- 我核对了读包：`PROJECT.md`、`AGENTS.md`、`DISPATCH.md` 三份哈希与派单时完全一致，执行方候选与来源未变，因此续派不需要重派或重写，也不存在“核验基于过期版本”的风险。
- 按宿主规则，首次中断可续派到原会话，我用同一会话 `reused:true` 恢复，未新开同义会话，避免覆盖关系与账本重复。
- 未向核验方加入任何预判结论，续派说明只重申标准与“勿沿用执行方结论”。

**未决与风险**
- 若同一核验会话再次中断，我会把实际阻塞（而非“难做”）记入台账，并考虑换独立会话重核；目前只是第 1 次中断，不构成阻塞。
- 旧计划 4 项（看板动画、中文 FAQ、课堂测验、来源链接复核）仍 pending，按要求留到事实验收后统一处置，现在不动。

**下一步**：等 first-review 回执 → 不合格则退回执行方原位修订、必要补查 → 通过则交独立反证 → 读最新账本与现状逐项处置 → 写 ledger.md。等待子会话，本轮结束。

sections.name: building-loop.phase
sections.text:
building-loop role=executor phase=supplement
补查。先读当前目标和退回回执，旧派单与新目标冲突时以当前目标为准。用 preflight 获取待改项，按原始证据原位修订，保留编号，出处路径和原文行写在同一行，例如 第 2-3 行。勿把内部修订说明混入成稿。完整读回后 submit 带六项 quality。未读当前目标、未落实退回项或复算不符会被拦住。
本阶段先 building_loop prepare 获取真实可见读包和参数契约；pending仍有页就继续prepare或按行read。已读且版本未变不需重复读。交付后宿主结束本轮，不额外收尾或通知。
质量说明按任务规模写，小任务每项一两句具体内容。资料标实际来源及未证事项，结论和方法交代边界与取舍，给一个可行备选，先摘要后证据并留一句大白话。必要时引用文件和行号，细节留在正文，回执不用重复全文或哈希。
正文最后一个实质段须明确标为大白话或直白说明，错例、出处和附录放在它之前。
文件与阶段用 building_loop 和 building_loop_file。

content.text:
补查已签发（执行会话已按缓存阈值轮转为 66561ee6），现等待补查交付。

**本轮事实**
- 维护者已把目标从 G1 换成 G2（`PROJECT.md` 哈希由 9da564c 变为 147b1f4，第 2–5 行重写）：只交付 `module/candidate.md` 中文简明说明，本轮正文即最终成果；看板动画与互动测验取消、不再恢复；FAQ 意义由正文覆盖、验收后核对；来源链接复核仍有效。
- 首次核验回执 `records/audit-first.json`（decision=reject）已完整读到 289 行，结论是"部分对、部分错"：
  - **对且保留**：C1（completed 状态可对应 failure，github-checks.md 6–7 行）、C2（相关不蕴含因果，nist-scatter.md 第 6 行）、C3（A 级→送复核肯定前件，synthetic.md 4–5 行，已用"按本例规则"限定）、第 8–10 行。
  - **错、须原位改**：第 5 行 completed≠成功（contradiction）；第 6 行把相关推成对每个人的必然因果（invalid-inference，且缺"无随机分配、未排除共同因素"限制）；第 7 行把充分条件倒成"任何送复核者都是 A 级"（invalid-inference）。
  - **格式**：大白话必须在最后一个实质段，其后不得再有错例或附录。
  - 核验方自报的局限：网页只有短摘录，无法核对整页其他内容，已列 unverifiedSources。

**我的处置**
- 补查派单**未夹带预判结论**，只下发回执中的退回项与 G2 目标变更，要求执行方先重读 `PROJECT.md` 再改，避免沿用旧 G1 继续加看板/测验内容。
- 总纲要求"区分真实官方材料与明确标注的模拟记录"，我在派单中重申 primary 与 synthetic 的标注要求，这是规则复述，不是答案。

**下一步**：补查回执到后送复核（若合格）→ 独立反证 → 读最新账本并按 G2 处置 4 项旧计划（看板动画、课堂测验按第 4 行判失效/取消；FAQ 视覆盖关系；链接复核保留）→ 写 ledger.md。等待子会话，本轮结束。

已按最新总纲核对，并完成请求合并登记。本轮结论如下。

**事实（有证据）**
1. **总纲当前就是 G2，内容未再变化**：`PROJECT.md` 哈希仍是 `147b1f44…`，与我上一轮派发补查时读到的完全相同（第 1 行"一级总纲 · 中文简明说明"、第 2 行"目标已从 G1 改为 G2，只交付 module/candidate.md 的中文简明说明，本轮 K01 正文就是最终成果"）。所以本次"目标更新"通知触发前，我的续派要求**已经按 G2 下发**，不存在拿旧 G1 派单的滞后。
2. **补查仍在进行中**：K01 处于 `supplement`，执行会话是轮转后的 66561ee6（旧会话 1e6f0a85 因缓存阈值轮换），核验回执 `records/audit-first.json` 已被执行方消费，尚无新交付。
3. **请求合并**：新通知与 `request-609c7620727d186dce51` 是同一诉求（按最新总纲推进 K01 + 复盘账本），我用 `originId` 关联登记，未另起同义任务。

**已下发的续派要求（对照 G2 第 2–5 行逐条落实）**
| 总纲要求 | 派单落地 |
|---|---|
| 只交付 candidate.md 正文 | 明确"不再为看板/测验加内容" |
| 保留 C1/C2/C3 及出处 | 点名 C1(github 6–7 行)、C2(nist 第 6 行)、C3(synthetic 4–5 行) 保留 |
| 逐项修正其余错误 | 第 5 行 contradiction、第 6/7 行 invalid-inference 按回执 repair 原位改 |
| 区分真实官方与模拟记录 | 重申 primary 与 synthetic 的标注，不得把模拟案例说成外部真实研究 |
| 文末有大白话 | 大白话必须是最后一个实质段，其后不留错例/附录 |
| 不为详细新增无据断言 | 允许简短 |

**账本复盘预告（待验收后正式落账，现在不改状态）**
- `dashboard-animation`（看板动画）：总纲第 4 行"已取消，相关计划失效，不再恢复"→ 将判 `obsolete`。
- `paused-quiz`（课堂测验）：同条"互动测验已取消"→ 将判 `obsolete`（虽为 interrupted，但目标已明确不再恢复）。
- `extra-faq`（另写中文 FAQ）：第 4 行"意义由本轮说明正文覆盖，验收后核对"→ 待 K01 正文通过验收后判 `covered`，`coveredBy` 指向 K01；验收前不动。
- `future-link-check`（来源链接复核）：第 5 行"仍有效，留待安排"→ 判 `keep`。

**推测/未定**：核验方自报网页只有短摘录，无法核对整页其他内容；这与"来源链接复核"保留项有重叠，但我不会据此把链接复核判为已完成。

**下一步**：等补查交付 → 复核（C1–C3 与修订行）→ 独立反证 → 读最新账本按上表逐项处置 → 写 `ledger.md`。等待子会话，本轮结束。

| 计划项 | 处置 | 依据 |

| dashboard-animation（看板动画） | 失效（obsolete） | PROJECT.md 第 4 行"看板动画与互动测验已取消，相关计划失效，不再恢复" |

| request-609c7620727d186dce51 | 保留（keep） | K01 未达成：sources 未过、supplement 未提交 |
| request-c016c66720434bbce5f8 | 保留（keep），与上条同一诉求 | 已核实 PROJECT.md 哈希 147b1f4… 未再变，续派要求已按 G2 下发，账本已逐项核对；整项待 K01 验收后收口 |

2. 终审通过后交独立反证子会话复核。

**K01 实际阶段：`blocked`，未验收通过。** 已走路径：接单 → 首次核验（中途中断一次，续派后完成）→ 补查 → 终审 → 再补查 → 被预检拦住。

**稿件内容层面，终审判定是达标的**（`records/audit-final.json`）：
- `goalFit.pass=true`，C1/C2/C3 三条全部 `supported`，`coverage.rejected` 与 `formatIssues` 皆空；
- 首次退回的第 5/6/7 行三处错误（完成≠成功、相关≠个体必然因果、充分条件不能倒推），已在 24 行稿的第 12/13/15 行按证据原位改正；
- 结论/方法/备选/细节/大白话五项质量检查全过。

## 阻塞与判断

两次 preflight 报同一错，指"第 1 行、第 21 行是未登记事实"。但终审回执第 241–251 行早已把这两行按 nonfactual 列入 `unlisted`。执行方给的证据显示：现稿 26 行里第 1 行是标题、第 21 行是错例句、"大白话"标题在第 23 行——**报错用的是旧版 24 行稿的行号**。这是推测（预检器内部我没法看），但两次报错完全一致、且所指行内容对不上现稿，支持这个推断。

三条路我都试过或确认走不通：总控没有 coverage 写入入口（write 白名单只有 ledger.md）；`module/candidate.md` 不在我的读白名单，我连稿子都打不开；改预检器不在权限内。执行方请求我"补覆盖登记"，我做不到，也没有假装能做。

**我拒绝了一条捷径**：只要删掉标题、挪动错例、把大白话位置改掉，预检大概就过了。但这些都是终审已判 pass 的结构，那是拿"过闸"换"改对"，我没做。

|---|---|---|
| 看板动画 | **失效** | PROJECT.md 第 4 行"已取消，不再恢复" |
| 课堂测验 | **失效** | 同第 4 行"互动测验已取消"，暂停项不再恢复 |

| 两条请求项 | **保留** | K01 未达成，整项待收口 |

**独立反证还没做**，K01 也没收口。下一步：解阻 → 提交并终审 sources → 独立反证 → 再判 FAQ 覆盖、收口两条请求。

- insert:
    - id: preset-building-loop
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: building-loop
        name: building-loop
        description: >-
          面向项目建设、深度研究和跨多轮会话的长任务。用三级文件与原始证据保持项目现状，
          让总控只管全貌与进度，执行和核验各用授权子会话，减少主会话的细节污染和重复交接。
          同一单元默认续做，补查逐条核退回项，数字按原始数据复算，来源核验绑定实际读取和版本。
          每轮验收后强制读任务账本，结合最新项目现状处置后续、临时和搁置事项，再继续长期任务。
        order: 9
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: >-
                你在 building-loop 模式。按用户的目标和已授权范围行动，有实质歧义先问清。
                工作区以文件和原始证据为准。开工先从总纲定位分块，按需读正文和更新记录。
                使用 building_loop 与 building_loop_file。每步依据宿主注入的角色和阶段规则。
                总控维护全貌和进度，调查与修订交给执行方，验收方独立查证。
                后续计划、临时需求与中断事项通过 building_loop_ledger 维护，验收后结合当前项目逐项复盘。
                追查原因和边界，复查反例、替代方案、数据和遗漏。回复分清事实、推测与未知，
                最后用具体证据和大白话说明结果。

          - id: building-loop-governance
            name: 'dsh-building-loop/governance'

          # ── shell ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # `shell-env` stays in the HOST composition: `apps/cli/src/web.ts` injects it to
          # publish `DSH_WEB_URL`/`DSH_WEB_MODE`, and a host row that injects a service is
          # the criterion for host-plane ownership — injection resolves before any session
          # exists, so there is no agent to key by. Behind a preset realm those variables
          # never reached the model's shell at all. Both shell tools consume the host
          # registry from here; their executors (`bash-sandbox`/`pwsh-sandbox`) are
          # host-plane too.
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'

          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'

          # ── filesystem ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # Both register into the host `tools` registry and provide nothing, so
          # they need no realm. The `fs` service and its policy stay in the host.
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'

          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false

          # ── background jobs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # Only the model-facing controls. The task REGISTRY stays on the host plane:
          # its producers sit outside any realm this file could put it in — `tool-bash`
          # above resolves it with `ctx.get`, and an entry-local realm here is invisible
          # to every sibling row, so `run_in_background` would answer "background jobs
          # unavailable" while these controls sat in the catalog. The registry is keyed by
          # owning agent anyway, so one host instance serves every session. What a preset
          # chooses is whether its agent can collect and stop background work at all.
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'

          # ── skills ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # The skill REGISTRY lives in the host composition and is layered per scope:
          # these rows register into THIS preset's layer of it, so they need no realm.
          # `skill-filesystem` contributes local-root discovery for agents on this preset, and
          # `tool-skill` gives them the catalog and loader; the merged catalog also
          # carries whatever the deployment registered globally (repository plugins).
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
            config:
              customSkillDirs:
                - !!js >-
                  process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(
                    process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').dirname(
                      process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('dsh-building-loop/package.json')
                    ), 'skills'
                  )
              agentsHome: !!js >-
                process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(
                  process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').dirname(
                    process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('dsh-building-loop/package.json')
                  ), 'skills-disabled'
                )

          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'

          # ── goals ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # The goal service and session driver stay on the host plane, where the Gateway
          # can resolve them. The human command and model-facing tool register into this
          # preset's scoped layers.
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'

          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'

          # ── plan mode ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # Plan state is per-agent by nature, so an entry-local realm is not a
          # workaround here — it is the correct lifetime.
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until exit_plan_mode succeeds or the user switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.

          # ── compaction ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # `compaction-basic` reads `toolResultPrune` through `ctx.get`, so the pruner must
          # share this realm rather than sit outside it.
          #
          # `tokenMeter` is deliberately NOT in this realm: the meter stays on the HOST
          # plane, and the rows here resolve that one instance. It takes no configuration,
          # keys every fold by Session, and owns the context-meter projection units the
          # browser reads for every session — behind a realm those units would come and go
          # with whichever presets happen to be mounted. What a preset chooses is whether
          # its agent compacts at all, which is `compaction-basic` below.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
                config:
                  auto: false

              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'

              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

          # ── delegation and workflows ────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # The `subagents` registry and its spawn/fork backends live in the HOST
          # composition: the registry is a process singleton whose cross-session queries
          # the api-proxy serves to the browser, and a provider name may only be
          # registered once. This preset contributes the delegation TOOLS, which resolve
          # that host registry.
          #
          # `workflows` is different — nothing outside an agent reads it — so every row
          # that reaches it shares one entry-local realm here, and a consumer left
          # outside would resolve a host registry this preset does not populate.
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'

              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelectionSettings: true
                  backgroundMode: continuable

              # Fork omits model selection so provider/model stay equal to the parent and
              # the inherited history remains eligible for KV Cache reuse. This preset
              # keeps fork continuable; parent and child inherit the same messaging tool,
              # while the parent id and return guidance follow the inherited history.
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
                  backgroundMode: continuable

              # Production dsh does not install these optional providers. Install the
              # matching Bundle in this Profile and restart the Host, then copy this
              # preset and remove `disabled` from the matching tool row. Host availability
              # alone grants no tool.
              - id: tool-subagent-codex
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: codex
                  toolName: subagent_codex
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed

              - id: tool-subagent-claude-code
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: claude-code
                  toolName: subagent_claude_code
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed

              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn

              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'

              - id: tool-ralph
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ralph'
                config:
                  subagentProvider: spawn
                  maxRounds: 64

          # ── remaining model-facing rows ─────────────────────────────────────────────

          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'

          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true

          # The `web` service and its search provider stay in the host composition; only
          # the model-facing tool is per-session.
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000

          # Capability floor: the shipped standard preset carries `present` (deliverable
          # file cards), so this mode must not be the poorer one. Same plugin, no config.
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'

          # 机制：回合被输出上限截断时自动续写。
          # 本模式的一个回合 = 一件交付；输出撞上 token 上限就会停在半路，
          # 剩下那一半要人打一句「继续」才动。这个插件把那一句接过去。
          # 四条边界写在源码注释里：source 显式标 plugin、连轮有上限、
          # 非截断清零、只管根代理。续轮插件从本包的导出入口加载。
          - id: building-loop-turn-resume
            name: 'dsh-building-loop/turn-resume'
            config:
              maxConsecutive: 3

Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least 3 consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.

Outside commands, configuration expressions, and code blocks, link every mention of an existing file, including repeats and tables, to its full path relative to the working directory or absolute; append #L24 or #L24-L30 to the target for known lines. sections.name: building-loop.phase
sections.text:
building-loop role=executor phase=supplement
补查。先读当前目标和退回回执，旧派单与新目标冲突时以当前目标为准。用 preflight 获取待改项，按原始证据原位修订，保留编号，出处路径和原文行写在同一行，例如 第 2-3 行。勿把内部修订说明混入成稿。完整读回后 submit 带六项 quality。未读当前目标、未落实退回项或复算不符会被拦住。
本阶段先 building_loop prepare 获取真实可见读包和参数契约；pending仍有页就继续prepare或按行read。已读且版本未变不需重复读。交付后宿主结束本轮，不额外收尾或通知。
质量说明按任务规模写，小任务每项一两句具体内容。资料标实际来源及未证事项，结论和方法交代边界与取舍，给一个可行备选，先摘要后证据并留一句大白话。必要时引用文件和行号，细节留在正文，回执不用重复全文或哈希。
正文最后一个实质段须明确标为大白话或直白说明，错例、出处和附录放在它之前。
文件与阶段用 building_loop 和 building_loop_file。

tools.name: building_loop
tools.description: 每阶段先prepare获取授权读包、版本、待读页和契约；重复prepare只给未读或变化内容。advance仅总控，preflight/submit仅执行，review仅核验，audit仅独立反证；交付后自动结束本轮。

unit.description: 总控 advance 必填；子会话动作省略时沿用宿主唯一授权单元。

checks.description: 这里只提交 claims/正文 C数字 的事实编号（如 C1/C2/C3）；B开头的全文块只在 building_loop_coverage record 提交，不放这里。

line.description: 退回项在候选中没有编号行时填写候选行号

file.description: supported 或 finding.kind=contradiction 均必填。实际已读原文路径，与 id/status 同级，不放 finding 内。

start.description: supported 或 contradiction 必填。原文起始行，1 起计，与 id/status 同级。

end.description: supported 或 contradiction 必填。原文结束行，1 起计，与 id/status 同级。

sources.description: 资料的原始出处、核实办法和仍待证的部分

content.text:
You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.

你在 building-loop 模式。按用户的目标和已授权范围行动，有实质歧义先问清。 工作区以文件和原始证据为准。开工先从总纲定位分块，按需读正文和更新记录。 使用 building_loop 与 building_loop_file。每步依据宿主注入的角色和阶段规则。 总控维护全貌和进度，调查与修订交给执行方，验收方独立查证。 后续计划、临时需求与中断事项通过 building_loop_ledger 维护，验收后结合当前项目逐项复盘。 追查原因和边界，复查反例、替代方案、数据和遗漏。回复分清事实、推测与未知， 最后用具体证据和大白话说明结果。

Non-zero exits are reported as `[exit code: N]` markers; investigate failures before moving on. On Windows a killed process settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker; treat a bare exit 1 after an interruption as a termination, not a command failure.

Track every background job id you start. You are notified in-session when a job finishes — do not busy-poll or sleep on one; keep working on independent steps and do not duplicate a running job's work. Before giving a final answer, collect every still-relevant job with job_output (set wait: true only when you are genuinely blocked on it), and job_kill jobs that stopped mattering.

create_goal may infer goal intent from a direct human request in any language. After session resume or fork, an active goal is disarmed: when a human asks to continue or resume in any wording or language, use update_goal action resume to rearm it. Mark complete only when the objective is actually achieved. Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least 3 consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.

Use the workflow tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a workflow or for large multi-agent orchestration: you write a JavaScript script (the tool description documents the exact format) that fans work out across many subagents with phases and structured results. For one or two delegations, prefer plain subagent calls.

Use the ralph tool ONLY when the direct human explicitly asks for a Ralph loop or fresh-agent iterative execution. Each Ralph round starts a fresh child with no conversation seed and uses the shared workspace as durable memory. Completion and blockers are worker reports, not independent evaluation. Use same-session goal tools for ordinary long-running objectives, and plain subagents or workflows for bounded delegation and fan-out.

Prefer showing the primary results within your final response alongside a brief explanation. Use ![Description](<path/to/image.png>) when an image supports an explanation or comparison. Use [Description](<path/to/image.png>) when referring to an image or listing files. Enclose Markdown file destinations in angle brackets, especially paths containing spaces. Do not call present just to list edited source files, or run commands to check whether a diff view will appear. Use present to publish complete deliverables, including images, Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks, when separate access helps the user. Hosts that support file cards can show the presented file with preview and open actions. Avoid repeating results already shown inline unless the separate card adds useful access. Outside commands, configuration expressions, and code blocks, link every mention of an existing file, including repeats and tables, to its full path relative to the working directory or absolute; append #L24 or #L24-L30 to the target for known lines. Use the filename or a clear alias as the label, adding only enough parent directories to distinguish files; keep full paths out of labels. Default to the name alone; when precise locations matter, append :24 or :24–30, with no # or L in the line suffix.

The runtime context names the DeepSeek Harness implementation checkout. The checkout location and current working directory are separate values and may differ; never infer the working directory from the checkout path. Use pwd to determine the current working directory. Use this checkout only to inspect or extend DSH itself.

You are interacting with the user through the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose URL the runtime context names. When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. The client-plugin HMR receiver is active, but client-plugin changes reload without a refresh only while `pnpm run dev:web` is also running from this same checkout to rebuild their bundles; verify that watcher before promising automatic updates. Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. Starting another server does not update this GUI. The apps/web Vite entry builds the shell but is not a standalone application because only dsh web injects window.__DSH_BOOT__. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks; if one is needed, use a managed background job and verify its exact URL.
你是总控。先读当前 PROJECT.md，推进 K01 从原样接单到独立核验、必要补查、独立反证及账本复盘。不要把预判答案发给核验方。维护者会更新目标，按最新目标处置旧计划，最后把实际阶段与账本结果写入 ledger.md。等待子会话时可结束本轮，宿主会唤醒。

等待执行方交付，本轮结束。

**本轮动作**
- 收执前先重取读包确认版本：PROJECT.md、AGENTS.md、DISPATCH.md 哈希与派单时一致，目标未被维护者改动，核验依据稳定。

**给核验方的范围（只给标准，不含答案）**
- 逐条核正文、证据与推导，不以执行方自述为依据；
- C1/C2/C3 的含义与来源是否与原文一致；
- 每条额外断言是否有实际读到的原文支撑，缺证据即标 missing-evidence；
- 字段、相关与因果、有限规则推导三层的边界是否被越界表述；
- 文末大白话须与正文结论同义，不能拔高；
- 模拟案例不得写成外部真实研究；
- 错误按候选行号原位退回，正确内容原样保留。

**下一步**：核验回执到达后，若不合格退回执行方原位修订并促成必要补查；通过则转独立反证子会话复核，随后读最新账本与项目现状逐项处置旧计划，最后写 ledger.md。等待子会话，本轮结束。

**本轮处置（事实）**
- 核验方上次中断原因：子会话报 error，报错前最后动作是“取全文清单”，**尚未提交任何核验结论**，即无半成品判定被沿用。

补查已签发（执行会话已按缓存阈值轮转为 66561ee6），现等待补查交付。

**本轮事实**
- 维护者已把目标从 G1 换成 G2（`PROJECT.md` 哈希由 9da564c 变为 147b1f4，第 2–5 行重写）：只交付 `module/candidate.md` 中文简明说明，本轮正文即最终成果；看板动画与互动测验取消、不再恢复；FAQ 意义由正文覆盖、验收后核对；来源链接复核仍有效。
- 首次核验回执 `records/audit-first.json`（decision=reject）已完整读到 289 行，结论是"部分对、部分错"：
  - **对且保留**：C1（completed 状态可对应 failure，github-checks.md 6–7 行）、C2（相关不蕴含因果，nist-scatter.md 第 6 行）、C3（A 级→送复核肯定前件，synthetic.md 4–5 行，已用"按本例规则"限定）、第 8–10 行。
  - **错、须原位改**：第 5 行 completed≠成功（contradiction）；第 6 行把相关推成对每个人的必然因果（invalid-inference，且缺"无随机分配、未排除共同因素"限制）；第 7 行把充分条件倒成"任何送复核者都是 A 级"（invalid-inference）。
  - **格式**：大白话必须在最后一个实质段，其后不得再有错例或附录。
  - 核验方自报的局限：网页只有短摘录，无法核对整页其他内容，已列 unverifiedSources。

**我的处置**
- 补查派单**未夹带预判结论**，只下发回执中的退回项与 G2 目标变更，要求执行方先重读 `PROJECT.md` 再改，避免沿用旧 G1 继续加看板/测验内容。
- 总纲要求"区分真实官方材料与明确标注的模拟记录"，我在派单中重申 primary 与 synthetic 的标注要求，这是规则复述，不是答案。

**下一步**：补查回执到后送复核（若合格）→ 独立反证 → 读最新账本并按 G2 处置 4 项旧计划（看板动画、课堂测验按第 4 行判失效/取消；FAQ 视覆盖关系；链接复核保留）→ 写 ledger.md。等待子会话，本轮结束。

已按最新总纲核对，并完成请求合并登记。本轮结论如下。

**事实（有证据）**
1. **总纲当前就是 G2，内容未再变化**：`PROJECT.md` 哈希仍是 `147b1f44…`，与我上一轮派发补查时读到的完全相同（第 1 行"一级总纲 · 中文简明说明"、第 2 行"目标已从 G1 改为 G2，只交付 module/candidate.md 的中文简明说明，本轮 K01 正文就是最终成果"）。所以本次"目标更新"通知触发前，我的续派要求**已经按 G2 下发**，不存在拿旧 G1 派单的滞后。
2. **补查仍在进行中**：K01 处于 `supplement`，执行会话是轮转后的 66561ee6（旧会话 1e6f0a85 因缓存阈值轮换），核验回执 `records/audit-first.json` 已被执行方消费，尚无新交付。
3. **请求合并**：新通知与 `request-609c7620727d186dce51` 是同一诉求（按最新总纲推进 K01 + 复盘账本），我用 `originId` 关联登记，未另起同义任务。

**已下发的续派要求（对照 G2 第 2–5 行逐条落实）**
| 总纲要求 | 派单落地 |
|---|---|
| 只交付 candidate.md 正文 | 明确"不再为看板/测验加内容" |
| 保留 C1/C2/C3 及出处 | 点名 C1(github 6–7 行)、C2(nist 第 6 行)、C3(synthetic 4–5 行) 保留 |
| 逐项修正其余错误 | 第 5 行 contradiction、第 6/7 行 invalid-inference 按回执 repair 原位改 |
| 区分真实官方与模拟记录 | 重申 primary 与 synthetic 的标注，不得把模拟案例说成外部真实研究 |
| 文末有大白话 | 大白话必须是最后一个实质段，其后不留错例/附录 |
| 不为详细新增无据断言 | 允许简短 |

**账本复盘预告（待验收后正式落账，现在不改状态）**
- `dashboard-animation`（看板动画）：总纲第 4 行"已取消，相关计划失效，不再恢复"→ 将判 `obsolete`。
- `paused-quiz`（课堂测验）：同条"互动测验已取消"→ 将判 `obsolete`（虽为 interrupted，但目标已明确不再恢复）。
- `extra-faq`（另写中文 FAQ）：第 4 行"意义由本轮说明正文覆盖，验收后核对"→ 待 K01 正文通过验收后判 `covered`，`coveredBy` 指向 K01；验收前不动。
- `future-link-check`（来源链接复核）：第 5 行"仍有效，留待安排"→ 判 `keep`。

**推测/未定**：核验方自报网页只有短摘录，无法核对整页其他内容；这与"来源链接复核"保留项有重叠，但我不会据此把链接复核判为已完成。

**下一步**：等补查交付 → 复核（C1–C3 与修订行）→ 独立反证 → 读最新账本按上表逐项处置 → 写 `ledger.md`。等待子会话，本轮结束。

- 补查已完成并交付，K01 由 `supplement` 走到 `final-review-ready`，执行会话 66561ee6 已结束，不会再有动作。

**给终审的范围（标准，不含答案）**

- 稿件的实际修订效果、格式是否达标，只有终审回执能证实，我现在不作判断。

补查已签发，现等交付。

**本轮事实（均有回执原文支撑）**
- 终审回执 `records/audit-final.json` 的关键判定（读至 263 行）：
  - `decision: reject`，但**内容层面全过**：`goalFit.pass=true`（第 18 行按 PROJECT.md 第 2–5 行逐条对齐）；C1/C2/C3 三条 check 全 `supported`；`coverage.rejected` 为空、`formatIssues` 为空；`quality` 六项里 `conclusion/method/alternatives/detail/plain` 均 pass。
  - 新稿候选 sha 由 `dabcb6f…` 变为 `cc8a7d4…`（24 行），首次退回的第 5/6/7 行对应内容已按 repair 原位改写为第 12/13/15 行（回执第 97 行）。
  - **唯一退回项**：`qualityRejected: ["sources"]`。
- 退回的实质原因（第 93 行）不是稿子说错了，而是**核对链条没闭合**：核验方自报 `records/audit-first.json` 不在其读白名单，"其要求依据派单转述核对"；第 253–256 行另列 `unverifiedSources`（NIST/GitHub 页面除摘录句外未核）。
- 执行侧已第二次按缓存阈值轮转：66561ee6 → 537b3911。

**我的判断（区分事实与推测）**
- 事实：稿件的三块出处、三处修订、格式与分层都已通过独立核验。
- 事实：`sources` 退回源于"核验方读不到首次回执 + 页面短摘录"这两个可追溯性缺口。
- 推测：让正文自带"文件+行号+状态码行号"和"非全页存档、其余未核"的显式声明，可让下一次核验不依赖口头转述即完成比对——这是我选定的补救方式，尚未验证有效。

**派单口径（只发标准）**
- 补足可追溯性两点：每条 primary 出处写清文件/行号/状态码所在行；显式标注短摘录、非全页、其余内容留待后续来源复核。
- 明确"不动"的清单：C1/C2/C3 及行号、第 12/13/15 行已改内容、错例位置、第 23 行大白话、[推测] 标注、primary/synthetic 区分。
- 重申禁令：不冒称外部真实研究、不新增无据断言、不加看板/测验内容。

**账本**：4 项旧计划与 2 条请求项仍 pending，按 G2 第 4–5 行的处置方案待最终验收后一次性落账，现在不改状态，避免"未验收先标完成"。

**下一步**：等补查交付 → 终审（聚焦 sources 是否闭合）→ 独立反证 → 账本复盘 + 写 `ledger.md`。等待子会话，本轮结束。

续派成功，K01 已回到 `supplement` 运行中，执行会话仍为 537b3911（`reused:true`）。

**本轮核实的事实**
1. **执行方的实质工作已完成**：它自报在 `module/candidate.md` 第 8 行新增出处凭据（C1→`sources/github-checks.md` 第2行 URL + `source-checks.json` 第4–15行；C2→`sources/nist-scatter.md` 第2行 URL + 第19–28行），并声明短摘录、非全页、其余未核属后续来源复核。这与终审回执第 253–256 行的 `unverifiedSources` 两项正面对应，属于对症修补——但**我无法亲自验证这句自述**，因为候选文件不在总控读白名单（我尝试读取返回"该文件不在当前读白名单"），只能等终审复核。
2. **卡点是工具链而非内容**：preflight 把候选第 1 行标题「# 检查结果与观测说明」和第 21 行小节标题「## 三、大白话」当成"未登记事实"。而终审回执第 241–251 行已把这两行列入 `unlisted` 并按 nonfactual 处理，`coverage.rejected`、`formatIssues` 都为空。
3. **执行方请求我做的事，我做不到**：`status` 回传确认总控 write 白名单只有 `ledger.md`，**没有 coverage 写入入口**，也无法修改预检器。它请求"总控补覆盖登记或调整预检"，超出我的权限，我不能假装能做。

**我的处置与取舍**
- 续派而不是重开会话：同一会话有完整上下文（24→26 行的改动历史），重开等于让它重做一遍。
- 明确告诉它**别再等我补覆盖记录**，两条路都超权限；让它按终审回执既有判据在提交说明中声明这两行为 nonfactual，或重跑 preflight 让宿主持久化的覆盖记录生效。
- 划了红线：不许为了让预检通过而删标题、挪错例、移大白话、动 C1/C2/C3 与 `[推测]`——那是拿"过闸"换"改对"。
- 要求它若再被同一处拦住，**整段回传 preflight 原文报错**，避免反复空转；这已是该单元第 1 次 blocked，若反复出现，我会把"预检器把标题行判为事实块"这个真实阻塞记入台账，而不是继续消耗轮次。

**当前状态**：稿件内容层面终审已认定达标（goalFit pass、C1/C2/C3 supported、无 rejected 块），只剩 `quality=sources` 一项与技术性提交闸口未闭合。**尚未交给独立反证，也尚未写 `ledger.md`**，不会提前宣布验收通过。

**下一步**：等重试结果 → 若提交成功则终审（专看 sources 是否闭合）→ 独立反证 → 账本按 G2 逐项处置并写 `ledger.md`。等待子会话，本轮结束。

You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.

你在 building-loop 模式。按用户的目标和已授权范围行动，有实质歧义先问清。 工作区以文件和原始证据为准。开工先从总纲定位分块，按需读正文和更新记录。 使用 building_loop 与 building_loop_file。每步依据宿主注入的角色和阶段规则。 总控维护全貌和进度，调查与修订交给执行方，验收方独立查证。 后续计划、临时需求与中断事项通过 building_loop_ledger 维护，验收后结合当前项目逐项复盘。 追查原因和边界，复查反例、替代方案、数据和遗漏。回复分清事实、推测与未知， 最后用具体证据和大白话说明结果。

Non-zero exits are reported as `[exit code: N]` markers; investigate failures before moving on. On Windows a killed process settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker; treat a bare exit 1 after an interruption as a termination, not a command failure.

Track every background job id you start. You are notified in-session when a job finishes — do not busy-poll or sleep on one; keep working on independent steps and do not duplicate a running job's work. Before giving a final answer, collect every still-relevant job with job_output (set wait: true only when you are genuinely blocked on it), and job_kill jobs that stopped mattering.

create_goal may infer goal intent from a direct human request in any language. After session resume or fork, an active goal is disarmed: when a human asks to continue or resume in any wording or language, use update_goal action resume to rearm it. Mark complete only when the objective is actually achieved. Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least 3 consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.

Use the workflow tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a workflow or for large multi-agent orchestration: you write a JavaScript script (the tool description documents the exact format) that fans work out across many subagents with phases and structured results. For one or two delegations, prefer plain subagent calls.

Use the ralph tool ONLY when the direct human explicitly asks for a Ralph loop or fresh-agent iterative execution. Each Ralph round starts a fresh child with no conversation seed and uses the shared workspace as durable memory. Completion and blockers are worker reports, not independent evaluation. Use same-session goal tools for ordinary long-running objectives, and plain subagents or workflows for bounded delegation and fan-out.

Prefer showing the primary results within your final response alongside a brief explanation. Use ![Description](<path/to/image.png>) when an image supports an explanation or comparison. Use [Description](<path/to/image.png>) when referring to an image or listing files. Enclose Markdown file destinations in angle brackets, especially paths containing spaces. Do not call present just to list edited source files, or run commands to check whether a diff view will appear. Use present to publish complete deliverables, including images, Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks, when separate access helps the user. Hosts that support file cards can show the presented file with preview and open actions. Avoid repeating results already shown inline unless the separate card adds useful access. Outside commands, configuration expressions, and code blocks, link every mention of an existing file, including repeats and tables, to its full path relative to the working directory or absolute; append #L24 or #L24-L30 to the target for known lines. Use the filename or a clear alias as the label, adding only enough parent directories to distinguish files; keep full paths out of labels. Default to the name alone; when precise locations matter, append :24 or :24–30, with no # or L in the line suffix.

The runtime context names the DeepSeek Harness implementation checkout. The checkout location and current working directory are separate values and may differ; never infer the working directory from the checkout path. Use pwd to determine the current working directory. Use this checkout only to inspect or extend DSH itself.

You are interacting with the user through the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose URL the runtime context names. When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. The client-plugin HMR receiver is active, but client-plugin changes reload without a refresh only while `pnpm run dev:web` is also running from this same checkout to rebuild their bundles; verify that watcher before promising automatic updates. Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. Starting another server does not update this GUI. The apps/web Vite entry builds the shell but is not a standalone application because only dsh web injects window.__DSH_BOOT__. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks; if one is needed, use a managed background job and verify its exact URL.

每个事实段还须 sourceRelation=supports|contradicts|insufficient，单独判断原文对这句话字面含义的关系。不得猜测作者有意举反例、在做测试或暗含否定；正文没有明确标注错误，就当成作者提出的断言。识别到原文与断言相反必须退回，不能一边说矛盾一边 supported。inventory 标 requiresInference 的块中有明确推导关系，推导片段用 inference 并交证明；不能把两个前提的组合叫直接转述来省证明。原文引句须逐字，但候选可以忠实翻译或同义转述，不要求字字相同。
原句明确以“误读：”“错例：”“错误推理：”或 [误读]/[错例] 开头时，按 error-example 单列：sourceRelation 核其中展示的推理是 contradicts 或 insufficient，evidence 给实际反证或不足依据。宿主保留它作为已标注的错例，不作为已证前提；不要求作者为了核验换一个同义标签。没有显式标签绝不能用此分类。
质量说明按任务规模写，小任务每项一两句具体内容。资料标实际来源及未证事项，结论和方法交代边界与取舍，给一个可行备选，先摘要后证据并留一句大白话。必要时引用文件和行号，细节留在正文，回执不用重复全文或哈希。
正文最后一个实质段须明确标为大白话或直白说明，错例、出处和附录放在它之前。

原句明确以“误读：”“错例：”“错误推理：”或 [误读]/[错例] 开头时，按 error-example 单列：sourceRelation 核其中展示的推理是 contradicts 或 insufficient，evidence 给实际反证或不足依据。宿主保留它作为已标注的错例，不作为已证前提；不要求作者为了核验换一个同义标签。没有显式标签绝不能用此分类。
质量说明按任务规模写，小任务每项一两句具体内容。资料标实际来源及未证事项，结论和方法交代边界与取舍，给一个可行备选，先摘要后证据并留一句大白话。必要时引用文件和行号，细节留在正文，回执不用重复全文或哈希。
正文最后一个实质段须明确标为大白话或直白说明，错例、出处和附录放在它之前。
文件与阶段用 building_loop 和 building_loop_file。质量判断用 building_loop_quality。

# 项目规则
当前目标以 PROJECT.md 为准。所有角色使用宿主受控入口，核验依据实际读到的原文，不能把模拟案例说成外部真实研究。

# 派单要求
首次接单原样送审；独立核验逐条核正文、证据与推导。错误退回执行方原位修订，正确内容保留。

tools.name: building_loop_coverage
tools.description: 按宿主全文清单逐块核验。inventory分页取全文；record每次1–12块，部分错误只重交invalid块；status默认只给进度，可用block取单块证明。

block.description: status 可选：只取这一块已有的详细证明；省略时只返回进度摘要。

entries.description: 每次提交1至12块，按 inventory 分页分批提交；不能把全文超过12块塞进一次调用。

quote.description: 单一判断可省略，自动取该块完整原文；复合判断须逐段连续覆盖本块，不能把下一块文字并入。匹配失败按 coverage-span 的 part/cursor/expectedSuffix 修正核验参数，不得改写正文或省掉事实。

status.description: direct/inference 给事实判定；nonfactual 用 supported；hypothesis 宿主固定 uncertain，不能成为已证前提。

sourceRelation.description: direct/inference 必填：原始证据对该断言字面含义的关系。error-example 核展示的错误推理，只能 contradicts/insufficient，并提供 evidence；明确错例的状态由宿主固定，不作为已证前提。

scope.description: 具体说明适用对象、概念和条件，可用短句或明确的 objects/conditions 对象。

formal.description: modus-ponens 的两项依次为 implies(P,Q)、asserts(P)，结论 asserts(Q)；equality-transitive 为 equals(A,B)、equals(B,C)，结论 equals(A,C)。premises 与原文前提顺序一致。

left.description: 具体命题/对象标识。implies 表示 left→right；asserts 仅断言 left；equals 表示 left=right。同一命题必须用相同字符串。

right.description: 仅 implies/equals 必填；asserts 必须省略，不填空串或复述左项。

content.text:
You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.

你在 building-loop 模式。按用户的目标和已授权范围行动，有实质歧义先问清。 工作区以文件和原始证据为准。开工先从总纲定位分块，按需读正文和更新记录。 使用 building_loop 与 building_loop_file。每步依据宿主注入的角色和阶段规则。 总控维护全貌和进度，调查与修订交给执行方，验收方独立查证。 后续计划、临时需求与中断事项通过 building_loop_ledger 维护，验收后结合当前项目逐项复盘。 追查原因和边界，复查反例、替代方案、数据和遗漏。回复分清事实、推测与未知， 最后用具体证据和大白话说明结果。

Non-zero exits are reported as `[exit code: N]` markers; investigate failures before moving on. On Windows a killed process settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker; treat a bare exit 1 after an interruption as a termination, not a command failure.

Track every background job id you start. You are notified in-session when a job finishes — do not busy-poll or sleep on one; keep working on independent steps and do not duplicate a running job's work. Before giving a final answer, collect every still-relevant job with job_output (set wait: true only when you are genuinely blocked on it), and job_kill jobs that stopped mattering.

create_goal may infer goal intent from a direct human request in any language. After session resume or fork, an active goal is disarmed: when a human asks to continue or resume in any wording or language, use update_goal action resume to rearm it. Mark complete only when the objective is actually achieved. Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least 3 consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.

Use the workflow tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a workflow or for large multi-agent orchestration: you write a JavaScript script (the tool description documents the exact format) that fans work out across many subagents with phases and structured results. For one or two delegations, prefer plain subagent calls.

Use the ralph tool ONLY when the direct human explicitly asks for a Ralph loop or fresh-agent iterative execution. Each Ralph round starts a fresh child with no conversation seed and uses the shared workspace as durable memory. Completion and blockers are worker reports, not independent evaluation. Use same-session goal tools for ordinary long-running objectives, and plain subagents or workflows for bounded delegation and fan-out.

Prefer showing the primary results within your final response alongside a brief explanation. Use ![Description](<path/to/image.png>) when an image supports an explanation or comparison. Use [Description](<path/to/image.png>) when referring to an image or listing files. Enclose Markdown file destinations in angle brackets, especially paths containing spaces. Do not call present just to list edited source files, or run commands to check whether a diff view will appear. Use present to publish complete deliverables, including images, Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks, when separate access helps the user. Hosts that support file cards can show the presented file with preview and open actions. Avoid repeating results already shown inline unless the separate card adds useful access. Outside commands, configuration expressions, and code blocks, link every mention of an existing file, including repeats and tables, to its full path relative to the working directory or absolute; append #L24 or #L24-L30 to the target for known lines. Use the filename or a clear alias as the label, adding only enough parent directories to distinguish files; keep full paths out of labels. Default to the name alone; when precise locations matter, append :24 or :24–30, with no # or L in the line suffix.

The runtime context names the DeepSeek Harness implementation checkout. The checkout location and current working directory are separate values and may differ; never infer the working directory from the checkout path. Use pwd to determine the current working directory. Use this checkout only to inspect or extend DSH itself.

You are interacting with the user through the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose URL the runtime context names. When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. The client-plugin HMR receiver is active, but client-plugin changes reload without a refresh only while `pnpm run dev:web` is also running from this same checkout to rebuild their bundles; verify that watcher before promising automatic updates. Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. Starting another server does not update this GUI. The apps/web Vite entry builds the shell but is not a standalone application because only dsh web injects window.__DSH_BOOT__. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks; if one is needed, use a managed background job and verify its exact URL.
你是总控。先读当前 PROJECT.md，推进 K01 从原样接单到独立核验、必要补查、独立反证及账本复盘。不要把预判答案发给核验方。维护者会更新目标，按最新目标处置旧计划，最后把实际阶段与账本结果写入 ledger.md。等待子会话时可结束本轮，宿主会唤醒。

**给核验方的范围（只给标准，不含答案）**

- 文末大白话须与正文结论同义，不能拔高；
- 模拟案例不得写成外部真实研究；
- 错误按候选行号原位退回，正确内容原样保留。

续派成功：K01 已在原核验会话（a9a2aba4）恢复 first-review，单元状态回到 `running`，`interruptions:1` 已记录。

**本轮处置（事实）**
- 核验方上次中断原因：子会话报 error，报错前最后动作是“取全文清单”，**尚未提交任何核验结论**，即无半成品判定被沿用。
- 我核对了读包：`PROJECT.md`、`AGENTS.md`、`DISPATCH.md` 三份哈希与派单时完全一致，执行方候选与来源未变，因此续派不需要重派或重写，也不存在“核验基于过期版本”的风险。
- 按宿主规则，首次中断可续派到原会话，我用同一会话 `reused:true` 恢复，未新开同义会话，避免覆盖关系与账本重复。
- 未向核验方加入任何预判结论，续派说明只重申标准与“勿沿用执行方结论”。

**未决与风险**

**本轮事实**
- 维护者已把目标从 G1 换成 G2（`PROJECT.md` 哈希由 9da564c 变为 147b1f4，第 2–5 行重写）：只交付 `module/candidate.md` 中文简明说明，本轮正文即最终成果；看板动画与互动测验取消、不再恢复；FAQ 意义由正文覆盖、验收后核对；来源链接复核仍有效。
- 首次核验回执 `records/audit-first.json`（decision=reject）已完整读到 289 行，结论是"部分对、部分错"：
  - **对且保留**：C1（completed 状态可对应 failure，github-checks.md 6–7 行）、C2（相关不蕴含因果，nist-scatter.md 第 6 行）、C3（A 级→送复核肯定前件，synthetic.md 4–5 行，已用"按本例规则"限定）、第 8–10 行。
  - **错、须原位改**：第 5 行 completed≠成功（contradiction）；第 6 行把相关推成对每个人的必然因果（invalid-inference，且缺"无随机分配、未排除共同因素"限制）；第 7 行把充分条件倒成"任何送复核者都是 A 级"（invalid-inference）。
  - **格式**：大白话必须在最后一个实质段，其后不得再有错例或附录。
  - 核验方自报的局限：网页只有短摘录，无法核对整页其他内容，已列 unverifiedSources。

**我的处置**
- 补查派单**未夹带预判结论**，只下发回执中的退回项与 G2 目标变更，要求执行方先重读 `PROJECT.md` 再改，避免沿用旧 G1 继续加看板/测验内容。
- 总纲要求"区分真实官方材料与明确标注的模拟记录"，我在派单中重申 primary 与 synthetic 的标注要求，这是规则复述，不是答案。

**下一步**：补查回执到后送复核（若合格）→ 独立反证 → 读最新账本并按 G2 处置 4 项旧计划（看板动画、课堂测验按第 4 行判失效/取消；FAQ 视覆盖关系；链接复核保留）→ 写 ledger.md。等待子会话，本轮结束。

续派成功：K01 已在原核验会话（a9a2aba4）恢复 first-review，单元状态回到 `running`，`interruptions:1` 已记录。

**本轮处置（事实）**
- 核验方上次中断原因：子会话报 error，报错前最后动作是“取全文清单”，**尚未提交任何核验结论**，即无半成品判定被沿用。
- 我核对了读包：`PROJECT.md`、`AGENTS.md`、`DISPATCH.md` 三份哈希与派单时完全一致，执行方候选与来源未变，因此续派不需要重派或重写，也不存在“核验基于过期版本”的风险。
- 按宿主规则，首次中断可续派到原会话，我用同一会话 `reused:true` 恢复，未新开同义会话，避免覆盖关系与账本重复。
- 未向核验方加入任何预判结论，续派说明只重申标准与“勿沿用执行方结论”。

**未决与风险**
- 若同一核验会话再次中断，我会把实际阻塞（而非“难做”）记入台账，并考虑换独立会话重核；目前只是第 1 次中断，不构成阻塞。
- 旧计划 4 项（看板动画、中文 FAQ、课堂测验、来源链接复核）仍 pending，按要求留到事实验收后统一处置，现在不动。

**下一步**：等 first-review 回执 → 不合格则退回执行方原位修订、必要补查 → 通过则交独立反证 → 读最新账本与现状逐项处置 → 写 ledger.md。等待子会话，本轮结束。

tools.name: building_loop
tools.description: 每阶段先prepare获取授权读包、版本、待读页和契约；重复prepare只给未读或变化内容。advance仅总控，preflight/submit仅执行，review仅核验，audit仅独立反证；交付后自动结束本轮。

unit.description: 总控 advance 必填；子会话动作省略时沿用宿主唯一授权单元。

checks.description: 这里只提交 claims/正文 C数字 的事实编号（如 C1/C2/C3）；B开头的全文块只在 building_loop_coverage record 提交，不放这里。

line.description: 退回项在候选中没有编号行时填写候选行号

file.description: supported 或 finding.kind=contradiction 均必填。实际已读原文路径，与 id/status 同级，不放 finding 内。

start.description: supported 或 contradiction 必填。原文起始行，1 起计，与 id/status 同级。

end.description: supported 或 contradiction 必填。原文结束行，1 起计，与 id/status 同级。

sources.description: 资料的原始出处、核实办法和仍待证的部分

conclusion.description: 可支持的结论、修订理由与适用范围

method.description: 采用的方法、复算或反查及其局限

alternatives.description: 可行的备选、取舍和更合适的提议

detail.description: 先摘要后依据的层次、读者需要的细节

plain.description: 面向读者的一句大白话

tools.name: building_loop_file
tools.description: 按当前角色的准确路径白名单列出、读取、字面搜索或原子写入 UTF-8 文件。写入自动维护一份改前备份和逐文件日志。history 取授权文件的最近更新。

tools.name: building_loop_ledger
tools.description: 总控登记后续计划、临时需求和搁置事项。每轮事实验收后 read 最新账本，读取项目现状，再逐项 review，保留、续做、延期或有依据地完成、覆盖、失效。

content.text:
You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.

你在 building-loop 模式。按用户的目标和已授权范围行动，有实质歧义先问清。 工作区以文件和原始证据为准。开工先从总纲定位分块，按需读正文和更新记录。 使用 building_loop 与 building_loop_file。每步依据宿主注入的角色和阶段规则。 总控维护全貌和进度，调查与修订交给执行方，验收方独立查证。 后续计划、临时需求与中断事项通过 building_loop_ledger 维护，验收后结合当前项目逐项复盘。 追查原因和边界，复查反例、替代方案、数据和遗漏。回复分清事实、推测与未知， 最后用具体证据和大白话说明结果。

Non-zero exits are reported as `[exit code: N]` markers; investigate failures before moving on. On Windows a killed process settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker; treat a bare exit 1 after an interruption as a termination, not a command failure.

Track every background job id you start. You are notified in-session when a job finishes — do not busy-poll or sleep on one; keep working on independent steps and do not duplicate a running job's work. Before giving a final answer, collect every still-relevant job with job_output (set wait: true only when you are genuinely blocked on it), and job_kill jobs that stopped mattering.

create_goal may infer goal intent from a direct human request in any language. After session resume or fork, an active goal is disarmed: when a human asks to continue or resume in any wording or language, use update_goal action resume to rearm it. Mark complete only when the objective is actually achieved. Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least 3 consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.

Use the workflow tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a workflow or for large multi-agent orchestration: you write a JavaScript script (the tool description documents the exact format) that fans work out across many subagents with phases and structured results. For one or two delegations, prefer plain subagent calls.

Use the ralph tool ONLY when the direct human explicitly asks for a Ralph loop or fresh-agent iterative execution. Each Ralph round starts a fresh child with no conversation seed and uses the shared workspace as durable memory. Completion and blockers are worker reports, not independent evaluation. Use same-session goal tools for ordinary long-running objectives, and plain subagents or workflows for bounded delegation and fan-out.

Prefer showing the primary results within your final response alongside a brief explanation. Use ![Description](<path/to/image.png>) when an image supports an explanation or comparison. Use [Description](<path/to/image.png>) when referring to an image or listing files. Enclose Markdown file destinations in angle brackets, especially paths containing spaces. Do not call present just to list edited source files, or run commands to check whether a diff view will appear. Use present to publish complete deliverables, including images, Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks, when separate access helps the user. Hosts that support file cards can show the presented file with preview and open actions. Avoid repeating results already shown inline unless the separate card adds useful access. Outside commands, configuration expressions, and code blocks, link every mention of an existing file, including repeats and tables, to its full path relative to the working directory or absolute; append #L24 or #L24-L30 to the target for known lines. Use the filename or a clear alias as the label, adding only enough parent directories to distinguish files; keep full paths out of labels. Default to the name alone; when precise locations matter, append :24 or :24–30, with no # or L in the line suffix.

The runtime context names the DeepSeek Harness implementation checkout. The checkout location and current working directory are separate values and may differ; never infer the working directory from the checkout path. Use pwd to determine the current working directory. Use this checkout only to inspect or extend DSH itself.

You are interacting with the user through the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose URL the runtime context names. When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. The client-plugin HMR receiver is active, but client-plugin changes reload without a refresh only while `pnpm run dev:web` is also running from this same checkout to rebuild their bundles; verify that watcher before promising automatic updates. Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. Starting another server does not update this GUI. The apps/web Vite entry builds the shell but is not a standalone application because only dsh web injects window.__DSH_BOOT__. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks; if one is needed, use a managed background job and verify its exact URL.

You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.

你在 building-loop 模式。按用户的目标和已授权范围行动，有实质歧义先问清。 工作区以文件和原始证据为准。开工先从总纲定位分块，按需读正文和更新记录。 使用 building_loop 与 building_loop_file。每步依据宿主注入的角色和阶段规则。 总控维护全貌和进度，调查与修订交给执行方，验收方独立查证。 后续计划、临时需求与中断事项通过 building_loop_ledger 维护，验收后结合当前项目逐项复盘。 追查原因和边界，复查反例、替代方案、数据和遗漏。回复分清事实、推测与未知， 最后用具体证据和大白话说明结果。

Non-zero exits are reported as `[exit code: N]` markers; investigate failures before moving on. On Windows a killed process settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker; treat a bare exit 1 after an interruption as a termination, not a command failure.

Track every background job id you start. You are notified in-session when a job finishes — do not busy-poll or sleep on one; keep working on independent steps and do not duplicate a running job's work. Before giving a final answer, collect every still-relevant job with job_output (set wait: true only when you are genuinely blocked on it), and job_kill jobs that stopped mattering.

create_goal may infer goal intent from a direct human request in any language. After session resume or fork, an active goal is disarmed: when a human asks to continue or resume in any wording or language, use update_goal action resume to rearm it. Mark complete only when the objective is actually achieved. Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least 3 consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.

Use the workflow tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a workflow or for large multi-agent orchestration: you write a JavaScript script (the tool description documents the exact format) that fans work out across many subagents with phases and structured results. For one or two delegations, prefer plain subagent calls.

Use the ralph tool ONLY when the direct human explicitly asks for a Ralph loop or fresh-agent iterative execution. Each Ralph round starts a fresh child with no conversation seed and uses the shared workspace as durable memory. Completion and blockers are worker reports, not independent evaluation. Use same-session goal tools for ordinary long-running objectives, and plain subagents or workflows for bounded delegation and fan-out.

Prefer showing the primary results within your final response alongside a brief explanation. Use ![Description](<path/to/image.png>) when an image supports an explanation or comparison. Use [Description](<path/to/image.png>) when referring to an image or listing files. Enclose Markdown file destinations in angle brackets, especially paths containing spaces. Do not call present just to list edited source files, or run commands to check whether a diff view will appear. Use present to publish complete deliverables, including images, Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks, when separate access helps the user. Hosts that support file cards can show the presented file with preview and open actions. Avoid repeating results already shown inline unless the separate card adds useful access. Outside commands, configuration expressions, and code blocks, link every mention of an existing file, including repeats and tables, to its full path relative to the working directory or absolute; append #L24 or #L24-L30 to the target for known lines. Use the filename or a clear alias as the label, adding only enough parent directories to distinguish files; keep full paths out of labels. Default to the name alone; when precise locations matter, append :24 or :24–30, with no # or L in the line suffix.

The runtime context names the DeepSeek Harness implementation checkout. The checkout location and current working directory are separate values and may differ; never infer the working directory from the checkout path. Use pwd to determine the current working directory. Use this checkout only to inspect or extend DSH itself.

You are interacting with the user through the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose URL the runtime context names. When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. The client-plugin HMR receiver is active, but client-plugin changes reload without a refresh only while `pnpm run dev:web` is also running from this same checkout to rebuild their bundles; verify that watcher before promising automatic updates. Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. Starting another server does not update this GUI. The apps/web Vite entry builds the shell but is not a standalone application because only dsh web injects window.__DSH_BOOT__. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks; if one is needed, use a managed background job and verify its exact URL.

content.text:
You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.

你在 building-loop 模式。按用户的目标和已授权范围行动，有实质歧义先问清。 工作区以文件和原始证据为准。开工先从总纲定位分块，按需读正文和更新记录。 使用 building_loop 与 building_loop_file。每步依据宿主注入的角色和阶段规则。 总控维护全貌和进度，调查与修订交给执行方，验收方独立查证。 后续计划、临时需求与中断事项通过 building_loop_ledger 维护，验收后结合当前项目逐项复盘。 追查原因和边界，复查反例、替代方案、数据和遗漏。回复分清事实、推测与未知， 最后用具体证据和大白话说明结果。

Non-zero exits are reported as `[exit code: N]` markers; investigate failures before moving on. On Windows a killed process settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker; treat a bare exit 1 after an interruption as a termination, not a command failure.

Track every background job id you start. You are notified in-session when a job finishes — do not busy-poll or sleep on one; keep working on independent steps and do not duplicate a running job's work. Before giving a final answer, collect every still-relevant job with job_output (set wait: true only when you are genuinely blocked on it), and job_kill jobs that stopped mattering.

create_goal may infer goal intent from a direct human request in any language. After session resume or fork, an active goal is disarmed: when a human asks to continue or resume in any wording or language, use update_goal action resume to rearm it. Mark complete only when the objective is actually achieved. Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least 3 consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.

Use the workflow tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a workflow or for large multi-agent orchestration: you write a JavaScript script (the tool description documents the exact format) that fans work out across many subagents with phases and structured results. For one or two delegations, prefer plain subagent calls.

Use the ralph tool ONLY when the direct human explicitly asks for a Ralph loop or fresh-agent iterative execution. Each Ralph round starts a fresh child with no conversation seed and uses the shared workspace as durable memory. Completion and blockers are worker reports, not independent evaluation. Use same-session goal tools for ordinary long-running objectives, and plain subagents or workflows for bounded delegation and fan-out.

Prefer showing the primary results within your final response alongside a brief explanation. Use ![Description](<path/to/image.png>) when an image supports an explanation or comparison. Use [Description](<path/to/image.png>) when referring to an image or listing files. Enclose Markdown file destinations in angle brackets, especially paths containing spaces. Do not call present just to list edited source files, or run commands to check whether a diff view will appear. Use present to publish complete deliverables, including images, Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks, when separate access helps the user. Hosts that support file cards can show the presented file with preview and open actions. Avoid repeating results already shown inline unless the separate card adds useful access. 覆盖中的事实退回必须 finding={kind:missing-evidence|contradiction|scope|invalid-inference,quote:该段实际错误断言,fix:最小修正}；contradiction 还须 evidence 原文反证。只说“可以更详细”“结尾未复述全部要点”不是事实错误：不作外部事实主张的阅读建议或收尾可 nonfactual，必要写法走 quality，选做改进放 suggestions。不能把正确但简短的句子判 uncertain 来要求扩写。记录时的分类或参数错误由核验方修正，禁止因此让作者返工。

sections.text:
building-loop role=reviewer phase=final-review
终审。回到修订稿和原始证据，重新核对所有断言与改动。只有所有要求都支持才关单。
本阶段先 building_loop prepare 获取真实可见读包和参数契约；pending仍有页就继续prepare或按行read。已读且版本未变不需重复读。交付后宿主结束本轮，不额外收尾或通知。
先完整读当前目标文件、候选和引用原文。事实与写法分别判定：有据的事实应 supported，禁止因可选解释、排版或材料未提供的精度判 unsupported。事实退回须 finding={kind:"missing-evidence"|"contradiction"|"scope",quote:候选中实际存在的原句片段,fix:最小修正}；contradiction 还须 file/start/end 指向已读反证。不要要求补写原稿没有的新事实。事实支持后用 building_loop_quality assess：六项短依据、sourceRefs(file/start/end)、unverifiedSources、unlisted(line/basis)、revise；goalFit={pass,basis}明确现稿是否满足当前目标，符合便可通过，无需为“修订”而改字。质量退回须 revisions=[{field,change,requirement:{file,start,end}}]引用实际读取的目标或项目规则；可选改进放 suggestions，不阻止验收。最后 review 逐条 checks，支持项填 id/status="supported"/file/start/end/basis。空列表填 []。
sourceRefs 只填下列 evidence 白名单内的原始证据；候选、外部未核来稿和项目规则不能混充。unlisted 只填尚未编号、仍需查证的实际事实；空行、没有事实主张的标题、已核或已编号内容不要填，没有遗漏时填 []。需要判断的标题事实仍须列出。
必须先完整读正文和当前目标，再 building_loop_coverage inventory 取得宿主全文清单（分页读取全部），用 record 为每块提交 parts；一块只有一段可省 quote，多段须连续逐字覆盖。标题、表格、脚注、括号和引用后补充句同样要核。复合句的独立判断拆开。直接转述用 direct + evidence 的原文逐字 quote；推导用 inference，列 premises、scope（对象/概念/条件）、assumptions（无则 []）、counterexample。自然语言推导 rule=source-warrant 须给原文 warrant 桥接关系；形式规则或配置计算按工具契约。检查概念是否一致、条件有无倒置、相关能否推出因果、样本能否推广；能构造前提成立结论却不成立的反例，就不得 supported。证据不足可直接 unsupported/uncertain + repair，不必伪造证明。正确直接转述不要求新增事实；明确 [推测]/[假设]/[未证实] 才能分类 hypothesis，纯标题等才是 nonfactual。每条写具体 basis。coverage status 的 pending 必须清零才能交回执。结构齐全不等于语义正确，需要自己对原文核对。
覆盖中的事实退回必须 finding={kind:missing-evidence|contradiction|scope|invalid-inference,quote:该段实际错误断言,fix:最小修正}；contradiction 还须 evidence 原文反证。只说“可以更详细”“结尾未复述全部要点”不是事实错误：不作外部事实主张的阅读建议或收尾可 nonfactual，必要写法走 quality，选做改进放 suggestions。不能把正确但简短的句子判 uncertain 来要求扩写。记录时的分类或参数错误由核验方修正，禁止因此让作者返工。
每个事实段还须 sourceRelation=supports|contradicts|insufficient，单独判断原文对这句话字面含义的关系。不得猜测作者有意举反例、在做测试或暗含否定；正文没有明确标注错误，就当成作者提出的断言。识别到原文与断言相反必须退回，不能一边说矛盾一边 supported。inventory 标 requiresInference 的块中有明确推导关系，推导片段用 inference 并交证明；不能把两个前提的组合叫直接转述来省证明。原文引句须逐字，但候选可以忠实翻译或同义转述，不要求字字相同。
原句明确以“误读：”“错例：”“错误推理：”或 [误读]/[错例] 开头时，按 error-example 单列：sourceRelation 核其中展示的推理是 contradicts 或 insufficient，evidence 给实际反证或不足依据。宿主保留它作为已标注的错例，不作为已证前提；不要求作者为了核验换一个同义标签。没有显式标签绝不能用此分类。
质量说明按任务规模写，小任务每项一两句具体内容。资料标实际来源及未证事项，结论和方法交代边界与取舍，给一个可行备选，先摘要后证据并留一句大白话。必要时引用文件和行号，细节留在正文，回执不用重复全文或哈希。
正文最后一个实质段须明确标为大白话或直白说明，错例、出处和附录放在它之前。
文件与阶段用 building_loop 和 building_loop_file。质量判断用 building_loop_quality。

You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.

你在 building-loop 模式。按用户的目标和已授权范围行动，有实质歧义先问清。 工作区以文件和原始证据为准。开工先从总纲定位分块，按需读正文和更新记录。 使用 building_loop 与 building_loop_file。每步依据宿主注入的角色和阶段规则。 总控维护全貌和进度，调查与修订交给执行方，验收方独立查证。 后续计划、临时需求与中断事项通过 building_loop_ledger 维护，验收后结合当前项目逐项复盘。 追查原因和边界，复查反例、替代方案、数据和遗漏。回复分清事实、推测与未知， 最后用具体证据和大白话说明结果。

Non-zero exits are reported as `[exit code: N]` markers; investigate failures before moving on. On Windows a killed process settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker; treat a bare exit 1 after an interruption as a termination, not a command failure.

Track every background job id you start. You are notified in-session when a job finishes — do not busy-poll or sleep on one; keep working on independent steps and do not duplicate a running job's work. Before giving a final answer, collect every still-relevant job with job_output (set wait: true only when you are genuinely blocked on it), and job_kill jobs that stopped mattering.

create_goal may infer goal intent from a direct human request in any language. After session resume or fork, an active goal is disarmed: when a human asks to continue or resume in any wording or language, use update_goal action resume to rearm it. Mark complete only when the objective is actually achieved. Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least 3 consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.

Use the workflow tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a workflow or for large multi-agent orchestration: you write a JavaScript script (the tool description documents the exact format) that fans work out across many subagents with phases and structured results. For one or two delegations, prefer plain subagent calls.

Use the ralph tool ONLY when the direct human explicitly asks for a Ralph loop or fresh-agent iterative execution. Each Ralph round starts a fresh child with no conversation seed and uses the shared workspace as durable memory. Completion and blockers are worker reports, not independent evaluation. Use same-session goal tools for ordinary long-running objectives, and plain subagents or workflows for bounded delegation and fan-out.

Prefer showing the primary results within your final response alongside a brief explanation. Use ![Description](<path/to/image.png>) when an image supports an explanation or comparison. Use [Description](<path/to/image.png>) when referring to an image or listing files. Enclose Markdown file destinations in angle brackets, especially paths containing spaces. Do not call present just to list edited source files, or run commands to check whether a diff view will appear. Use present to publish complete deliverables, including images, Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks, when separate access helps the user. Hosts that support file cards can show the presented file with preview and open actions. Avoid repeating results already shown inline unless the separate card adds useful access. Outside commands, configuration expressions, and code blocks, link every mention of an existing file, including repeats and tables, to its full path relative to the working directory or absolute; append #L24 or #L24-L30 to the target for known lines. Use the filename or a clear alias as the label, adding only enough parent directories to distinguish files; keep full paths out of labels. Default to the name alone; when precise locations matter, append :24 or :24–30, with no # or L in the line suffix.

The runtime context names the DeepSeek Harness implementation checkout. The checkout location and current working directory are separate values and may differ; never infer the working directory from the checkout path. Use pwd to determine the current working directory. Use this checkout only to inspect or extend DSH itself.

You are interacting with the user through the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose URL the runtime context names. When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. The client-plugin HMR receiver is active, but client-plugin changes reload without a refresh only while `pnpm run dev:web` is also running from this same checkout to rebuild their bundles; verify that watcher before promising automatic updates. Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. Starting another server does not update this GUI. The apps/web Vite entry builds the shell but is not a standalone application because only dsh web injects window.__DSH_BOOT__. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks; if one is needed, use a managed background job and verify its exact URL.

**本轮动作**
- 收执前先重取读包确认版本：PROJECT.md、AGENTS.md、DISPATCH.md 哈希与派单时一致，目标未被维护者改动，核验依据稳定。

**给核验方的范围（只给标准，不含答案）**
- 逐条核正文、证据与推导，不以执行方自述为依据；
- C1/C2/C3 的含义与来源是否与原文一致；
- 每条额外断言是否有实际读到的原文支撑，缺证据即标 missing-evidence；
- 字段、相关与因果、有限规则推导三层的边界是否被越界表述；
- 文末大白话须与正文结论同义，不能拔高；
- 模拟案例不得写成外部真实研究；
- 错误按候选行号原位退回，正确内容原样保留。

**下一步**：核验回执到达后，若不合格退回执行方原位修订并促成必要补查；通过则转独立反证子会话复核，随后读最新账本与项目现状逐项处置旧计划，最后写 ledger.md。等待子会话，本轮结束。

**本轮处置（事实）**
- 核验方上次中断原因：子会话报 error，报错前最后动作是“取全文清单”，**尚未提交任何核验结论**，即无半成品判定被沿用。

补查已签发（执行会话已按缓存阈值轮转为 66561ee6），现等待补查交付。

**本轮事实**
- 维护者已把目标从 G1 换成 G2（`PROJECT.md` 哈希由 9da564c 变为 147b1f4，第 2–5 行重写）：只交付 `module/candidate.md` 中文简明说明，本轮正文即最终成果；看板动画与互动测验取消、不再恢复；FAQ 意义由正文覆盖、验收后核对；来源链接复核仍有效。
- 首次核验回执 `records/audit-first.json`（decision=reject）已完整读到 289 行，结论是"部分对、部分错"：
  - **对且保留**：C1（completed 状态可对应 failure，github-checks.md 6–7 行）、C2（相关不蕴含因果，nist-scatter.md 第 6 行）、C3（A 级→送复核肯定前件，synthetic.md 4–5 行，已用"按本例规则"限定）、第 8–10 行。
  - **错、须原位改**：第 5 行 completed≠成功（contradiction）；第 6 行把相关推成对每个人的必然因果（invalid-inference，且缺"无随机分配、未排除共同因素"限制）；第 7 行把充分条件倒成"任何送复核者都是 A 级"（invalid-inference）。
  - **格式**：大白话必须在最后一个实质段，其后不得再有错例或附录。
  - 核验方自报的局限：网页只有短摘录，无法核对整页其他内容，已列 unverifiedSources。

**我的处置**
- 补查派单**未夹带预判结论**，只下发回执中的退回项与 G2 目标变更，要求执行方先重读 `PROJECT.md` 再改，避免沿用旧 G1 继续加看板/测验内容。
- 总纲要求"区分真实官方材料与明确标注的模拟记录"，我在派单中重申 primary 与 synthetic 的标注要求，这是规则复述，不是答案。

**下一步**：补查回执到后送复核（若合格）→ 独立反证 → 读最新账本并按 G2 处置 4 项旧计划（看板动画、课堂测验按第 4 行判失效/取消；FAQ 视覆盖关系；链接复核保留）→ 写 ledger.md。等待子会话，本轮结束。

已按最新总纲核对，并完成请求合并登记。本轮结论如下。

**事实（有证据）**
1. **总纲当前就是 G2，内容未再变化**：`PROJECT.md` 哈希仍是 `147b1f44…`，与我上一轮派发补查时读到的完全相同（第 1 行"一级总纲 · 中文简明说明"、第 2 行"目标已从 G1 改为 G2，只交付 module/candidate.md 的中文简明说明，本轮 K01 正文就是最终成果"）。所以本次"目标更新"通知触发前，我的续派要求**已经按 G2 下发**，不存在拿旧 G1 派单的滞后。
2. **补查仍在进行中**：K01 处于 `supplement`，执行会话是轮转后的 66561ee6（旧会话 1e6f0a85 因缓存阈值轮换），核验回执 `records/audit-first.json` 已被执行方消费，尚无新交付。
3. **请求合并**：新通知与 `request-609c7620727d186dce51` 是同一诉求（按最新总纲推进 K01 + 复盘账本），我用 `originId` 关联登记，未另起同义任务。

**已下发的续派要求（对照 G2 第 2–5 行逐条落实）**
| 总纲要求 | 派单落地 |
|---|---|
| 只交付 candidate.md 正文 | 明确"不再为看板/测验加内容" |
| 保留 C1/C2/C3 及出处 | 点名 C1(github 6–7 行)、C2(nist 第 6 行)、C3(synthetic 4–5 行) 保留 |
| 逐项修正其余错误 | 第 5 行 contradiction、第 6/7 行 invalid-inference 按回执 repair 原位改 |
| 区分真实官方与模拟记录 | 重申 primary 与 synthetic 的标注，不得把模拟案例说成外部真实研究 |
| 文末有大白话 | 大白话必须是最后一个实质段，其后不留错例/附录 |
| 不为详细新增无据断言 | 允许简短 |

**账本复盘预告（待验收后正式落账，现在不改状态）**
- `dashboard-animation`（看板动画）：总纲第 4 行"已取消，相关计划失效，不再恢复"→ 将判 `obsolete`。
- `paused-quiz`（课堂测验）：同条"互动测验已取消"→ 将判 `obsolete`（虽为 interrupted，但目标已明确不再恢复）。
- `extra-faq`（另写中文 FAQ）：第 4 行"意义由本轮说明正文覆盖，验收后核对"→ 待 K01 正文通过验收后判 `covered`，`coveredBy` 指向 K01；验收前不动。
- `future-link-check`（来源链接复核）：第 5 行"仍有效，留待安排"→ 判 `keep`。

**推测/未定**：核验方自报网页只有短摘录，无法核对整页其他内容；这与"来源链接复核"保留项有重叠，但我不会据此把链接复核判为已完成。

**下一步**：等补查交付 → 复核（C1–C3 与修订行）→ 独立反证 → 读最新账本按上表逐项处置 → 写 `ledger.md`。等待子会话，本轮结束。

tools.description: 每阶段先prepare获取授权读包、版本、待读页和契约；重复prepare只给未读或变化内容。advance仅总控，preflight/submit仅执行，review仅核验，audit仅独立反证；交付后自动结束本轮。

unit.description: 总控 advance 必填；子会话动作省略时沿用宿主唯一授权单元。

checks.description: 这里只提交 claims/正文 C数字 的事实编号（如 C1/C2/C3）；B开头的全文块只在 building_loop_coverage record 提交，不放这里。

line.description: 退回项在候选中没有编号行时填写候选行号

file.description: supported 或 finding.kind=contradiction 均必填。实际已读原文路径，与 id/status 同级，不放 finding 内。

start.description: supported 或 contradiction 必填。原文起始行，1 起计，与 id/status 同级。

end.description: supported 或 contradiction 必填。原文结束行，1 起计，与 id/status 同级。

sources.description: 资料的原始出处、核实办法和仍待证的部分

conclusion.description: 可支持的结论、修订理由与适用范围

method.description: 采用的方法、复算或反查及其局限

alternatives.description: 可行的备选、取舍和更合适的提议

detail.description: 先摘要后依据的层次、读者需要的细节

plain.description: 面向读者的一句大白话

tools.name: building_loop_coverage
tools.description: 按宿主全文清单逐块核验。inventory分页取全文；record每次1–12块，部分错误只重交invalid块；status默认只给进度，可用block取单块证明。

block.description: status 可选：只取这一块已有的详细证明；省略时只返回进度摘要。

entries.description: 每次提交1至12块，按 inventory 分页分批提交；不能把全文超过12块塞进一次调用。

quote.description: 单一判断可省略，自动取该块完整原文；复合判断须逐段连续覆盖本块，不能把下一块文字并入。匹配失败按 coverage-span 的 part/cursor/expectedSuffix 修正核验参数，不得改写正文或省掉事实。

status.description: direct/inference 给事实判定；nonfactual 用 supported；hypothesis 宿主固定 uncertain，不能成为已证前提。

sourceRelation.description: direct/inference 必填：原始证据对该断言字面含义的关系。error-example 核展示的错误推理，只能 contradicts/insufficient，并提供 evidence；明确错例的状态由宿主固定，不作为已证前提。

scope.description: 具体说明适用对象、概念和条件，可用短句或明确的 objects/conditions 对象。

formal.description: modus-ponens 的两项依次为 implies(P,Q)、asserts(P)，结论 asserts(Q)；equality-transitive 为 equals(A,B)、equals(B,C)，结论 equals(A,C)。premises 与原文前提顺序一致。

left.description: 具体命题/对象标识。implies 表示 left→right；asserts 仅断言 left；equals 表示 left=right。同一命题必须用相同字符串。

right.description: 仅 implies/equals 必填；asserts 必须省略，不填空串或复述左项。

left.description: 具体命题/对象标识。implies 表示 left→right；asserts 仅断言 left；equals 表示 left=right。同一命题必须用相同字符串。

right.description: 仅 implies/equals 必填；asserts 必须省略，不填空串或复述左项。

tools.name: building_loop_file
tools.description: 按当前角色的准确路径白名单列出、读取、字面搜索或原子写入 UTF-8 文件。写入自动维护一份改前备份和逐文件日志。history 取授权文件的最近更新。

tools.name: building_loop_quality
tools.description: 独立核验方在 review 前记录六项质量依据。每项一句具体判断，revise 列出要退回的项，均通过时填 []。此工具不关单。

unit.description: 可省略，宿主沿用当前子会话唯一已授权单元；显式编号须与授权一致。

You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.

你在 building-loop 模式。按用户的目标和已授权范围行动，有实质歧义先问清。 工作区以文件和原始证据为准。开工先从总纲定位分块，按需读正文和更新记录。 使用 building_loop 与 building_loop_file。每步依据宿主注入的角色和阶段规则。 总控维护全貌和进度，调查与修订交给执行方，验收方独立查证。 后续计划、临时需求与中断事项通过 building_loop_ledger 维护，验收后结合当前项目逐项复盘。 追查原因和边界，复查反例、替代方案、数据和遗漏。回复分清事实、推测与未知， 最后用具体证据和大白话说明结果。

Non-zero exits are reported as `[exit code: N]` markers; investigate failures before moving on. On Windows a killed process settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker; treat a bare exit 1 after an interruption as a termination, not a command failure.

Track every background job id you start. You are notified in-session when a job finishes — do not busy-poll or sleep on one; keep working on independent steps and do not duplicate a running job's work. Before giving a final answer, collect every still-relevant job with job_output (set wait: true only when you are genuinely blocked on it), and job_kill jobs that stopped mattering.

create_goal may infer goal intent from a direct human request in any language. After session resume or fork, an active goal is disarmed: when a human asks to continue or resume in any wording or language, use update_goal action resume to rearm it. Mark complete only when the objective is actually achieved. Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least 3 consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.

Use the workflow tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a workflow or for large multi-agent orchestration: you write a JavaScript script (the tool description documents the exact format) that fans work out across many subagents with phases and structured results. For one or two delegations, prefer plain subagent calls.

Use the ralph tool ONLY when the direct human explicitly asks for a Ralph loop or fresh-agent iterative execution. Each Ralph round starts a fresh child with no conversation seed and uses the shared workspace as durable memory. Completion and blockers are worker reports, not independent evaluation. Use same-session goal tools for ordinary long-running objectives, and plain subagents or workflows for bounded delegation and fan-out.

Prefer showing the primary results within your final response alongside a brief explanation. Use ![Description](<path/to/image.png>) when an image supports an explanation or comparison. Use [Description](<path/to/image.png>) when referring to an image or listing files. Enclose Markdown file destinations in angle brackets, especially paths containing spaces. Do not call present just to list edited source files, or run commands to check whether a diff view will appear. Use present to publish complete deliverables, including images, Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks, when separate access helps the user. Hosts that support file cards can show the presented file with preview and open actions. Avoid repeating results already shown inline unless the separate card adds useful access. Outside commands, configuration expressions, and code blocks, link every mention of an existing file, including repeats and tables, to its full path relative to the working directory or absolute; append #L24 or #L24-L30 to the target for known lines. Use the filename or a clear alias as the label, adding only enough parent directories to distinguish files; keep full paths out of labels. Default to the name alone; when precise locations matter, append :24 or :24–30, with no # or L in the line suffix.

The runtime context names the DeepSeek Harness implementation checkout. The checkout location and current working directory are separate values and may differ; never infer the working directory from the checkout path. Use pwd to determine the current working directory. Use this checkout only to inspect or extend DSH itself.

You are interacting with the user through the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose URL the runtime context names. When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. The client-plugin HMR receiver is active, but client-plugin changes reload without a refresh only while `pnpm run dev:web` is also running from this same checkout to rebuild their bundles; verify that watcher before promising automatic updates. Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. Starting another server does not update this GUI. The apps/web Vite entry builds the shell but is not a standalone application because only dsh web injects window.__DSH_BOOT__. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks; if one is needed, use a managed background job and verify its exact URL.

以下均出自 synthetic.md 的合成逻辑样例，不是外部研究、生产日志或真实效果数据（出处：sources/synthetic.md 第 1 行；kind=synthetic）。

大白话：把“完成状态”“实际结果”和“证据能说明的范围”三件事分开看——状态标着完成，不等于结论就是成功；看到两个数字一起变，不等于一个导致另一个；一条“A 级要送复核”的规则，也反推不出所有被送复核的东西都是 A 级。

覆盖中的事实退回必须 finding={kind:missing-evidence|contradiction|scope|invalid-inference,quote:该段实际错误断言,fix:最小修正}；contradiction 还须 evidence 原文反证。只说“可以更详细”“结尾未复述全部要点”不是事实错误：不作外部事实主张的阅读建议或收尾可 nonfactual，必要写法走 quality，选做改进放 suggestions。不能把正确但简短的句子判 uncertain 来要求扩写。记录时的分类或参数错误由核验方修正，禁止因此让作者返工。
每个事实段还须 sourceRelation=supports|contradicts|insufficient，单独判断原文对这句话字面含义的关系。不得猜测作者有意举反例、在做测试或暗含否定；正文没有明确标注错误，就当成作者提出的断言。识别到原文与断言相反必须退回，不能一边说矛盾一边 supported。inventory 标 requiresInference 的块中有明确推导关系，推导片段用 inference 并交证明；不能把两个前提的组合叫直接转述来省证明。原文引句须逐字，但候选可以忠实翻译或同义转述，不要求字字相同。
原句明确以“误读：”“错例：”“错误推理：”或 [误读]/[错例] 开头时，按 error-example 单列：sourceRelation 核其中展示的推理是 contradicts 或 insufficient，evidence 给实际反证或不足依据。宿主保留它作为已标注的错例，不作为已证前提；不要求作者为了核验换一个同义标签。没有显式标签绝不能用此分类。
质量说明按任务规模写，小任务每项一两句具体内容。资料标实际来源及未证事项，结论和方法交代边界与取舍，给一个可行备选，先摘要后证据并留一句大白话。必要时引用文件和行号，细节留在正文，回执不用重复全文或哈希。
正文最后一个实质段须明确标为大白话或直白说明，错例、出处和附录放在它之前。
文件与阶段用 building_loop 和 building_loop_file。质量判断用 building_loop_quality。

tools.name: building_loop
tools.description: 每阶段先prepare获取授权读包、版本、待读页和契约；重复prepare只给未读或变化内容。advance仅总控，preflight/submit仅执行，review仅核验，audit仅独立反证；交付后自动结束本轮。

unit.description: 总控 advance 必填；子会话动作省略时沿用宿主唯一授权单元。

checks.description: 这里只提交 claims/正文 C数字 的事实编号（如 C1/C2/C3）；B开头的全文块只在 building_loop_coverage record 提交，不放这里。

line.description: 退回项在候选中没有编号行时填写候选行号

file.description: supported 或 finding.kind=contradiction 均必填。实际已读原文路径，与 id/status 同级，不放 finding 内。

start.description: supported 或 contradiction 必填。原文起始行，1 起计，与 id/status 同级。

end.description: supported 或 contradiction 必填。原文结束行，1 起计，与 id/status 同级。

sources.description: 资料的原始出处、核实办法和仍待证的部分

conclusion.description: 可支持的结论、修订理由与适用范围

tools.name: building_loop_coverage
tools.description: 按宿主全文清单逐块核验。inventory分页取全文；record每次1–12块，部分错误只重交invalid块；status默认只给进度，可用block取单块证明。

block.description: status 可选：只取这一块已有的详细证明；省略时只返回进度摘要。

entries.description: 每次提交1至12块，按 inventory 分页分批提交；不能把全文超过12块塞进一次调用。

quote.description: 单一判断可省略，自动取该块完整原文；复合判断须逐段连续覆盖本块，不能把下一块文字并入。匹配失败按 coverage-span 的 part/cursor/expectedSuffix 修正核验参数，不得改写正文或省掉事实。

status.description: direct/inference 给事实判定；nonfactual 用 supported；hypothesis 宿主固定 uncertain，不能成为已证前提。

sourceRelation.description: direct/inference 必填：原始证据对该断言字面含义的关系。error-example 核展示的错误推理，只能 contradicts/insufficient，并提供 evidence；明确错例的状态由宿主固定，不作为已证前提。

scope.description: 具体说明适用对象、概念和条件，可用短句或明确的 objects/conditions 对象。

formal.description: modus-ponens 的两项依次为 implies(P,Q)、asserts(P)，结论 asserts(Q)；equality-transitive 为 equals(A,B)、equals(B,C)，结论 equals(A,C)。premises 与原文前提顺序一致。

left.description: 具体命题/对象标识。implies 表示 left→right；asserts 仅断言 left；equals 表示 left=right。同一命题必须用相同字符串。

right.description: 仅 implies/equals 必填；asserts 必须省略，不填空串或复述左项。

left.description: 具体命题/对象标识。implies 表示 left→right；asserts 仅断言 left；equals 表示 left=right。同一命题必须用相同字符串。

right.description: 仅 implies/equals 必填；asserts 必须省略，不填空串或复述左项。

tools.description: 按当前角色的准确路径白名单列出、读取、字面搜索或原子写入 UTF-8 文件。写入自动维护一份改前备份和逐文件日志。history 取授权文件的最近更新。

tools.description: 独立核验方在 review 前记录六项质量依据。每项一句具体判断，revise 列出要退回的项，均通过时填 []。此工具不关单。
